blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University secured at least a playoff for a Final Four spot after dispatching National University, 85-63, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament Sunday at Araneta Coliseum. The Tamaraws improved to 8-5 after beating the top two teams in the league–the Bulldogs and University of the Philippines Fighting Maroons last week–in back-to-back fashion. “We just felt like we had a job to do and this is the first step in taking care of that job,” said coach Sean Chambers, whose squad suffered a 69-65 loss to NU in the first round last month. “We’re excited about it, […]...
